```sql
SELECT p."ID", COUNT(*) as abnormal_count
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' 
  AND l."Date" < DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND l."GOT" >= 60
  AND l."Date" <= DATE '1998-06-01'
GROUP BY p."ID"
```
